an-angler-s-guesthouse-where-the-ume-riv: An angler's guesthouse where the Ume River meets Lake Storuman. Char, trout, grayling and whitefish, five minutes from the door.
big-char-wild-trout-and-clear-northern-w: Big char, wild trout and clear northern water
slussfors-sits-where-the-ume-river-runs: Slussfors sits where the Ume River runs into Lake Storuman. The Kirjesån stream, known for its trout, joins the river just around the corner from the house, and the lakes Järvsjön, Magasjön and Boksjön are a short drive away.
the-secret-is-the-char-farm-just-below-t: The secret is the char farm just below the village (★ on the map). It feeds the water, so many large char and whitefish gather in a small area, summer and winter. It is what brings anglers from far away.
lake-storuman-and-part-of-the-ume-river: Lake Storuman and part of the Ume River. Char, trout, grayling and whitefish.
the-kirjes-n-stream-and-lake-nedre-lumni: The Kirjesån stream and Lake Nedre Lumnien. Mostly trout, with grayling and rainbow trout near the river mouth.
buy-the-licence-on-your-phone-before-you: Buy the licence on your phone before you cast, and check rules and size limits on the same page. Prices as listed on iFiske in November 2026.
we-do-not-rent-out-a-boat-ourselves-boat: We do not rent out a boat ourselves. Boats with or without motor can be rented locally: ask the Slussfors fishing association, contact Daniel Bergfors, +46 730 26 68 71, or look for private boats in Storuman municipality on Hygglo. You can also ask at the village shop Slussforsboa, +46 951 501 70. There is a public boat ramp in the village, and fuel is sold at the village petrol station.
the-star-of-slussfors-troll-or-jig-in-su: The star of Slussfors. Troll or jig in summer, and on the ice in late winter when the days are long and bright.
wild-trout-in-the-kirjes-n-stream-own-li: Wild trout in the Kirjesån stream (own licence, see above) and the river. Fly, spinner or a quiet drift at dusk in midsummer.
the-lady-of-the-stream-with-her-purple-s: The "lady of the stream", with her purple sail fin. Rises to small dry flies in the river currents through summer and autumn.
very-large-whitefish-are-caught-through: Very large whitefish are caught through the ice. Small jigs, light line and patience on a sunny March day.
our-rough-guide-ice-and-seasons-vary-fro: Our rough guide. Ice and seasons vary from year to year, and the licence page has the rules that apply.

slussfors-lies-on-the-e12-between-storum: Slussfors lies on the E12 between Storuman and the mountains. Switch between the nearby fishing waters and the wider region, and tap a place to fly there.

the-house-is-one-half-of-a-semi-detached: The house is one half of a semi-detached building with its own entrance, its own yard and plenty of parking for cars, boats and trailers. A groomed exercise trail of about 2.5 km for walking and skiing starts right behind the house.

yes-pets-are-welcome-please-keep-them-of: Yes, pets are welcome. Please keep them off the beds and sofas.
